messages:
alex_cs: Hey all — kicking off Medinexus onboarding (HIPAA, needs Private/VPC + Dedicated). Quick goal: pilot in 6 weeks. Stakeholders: Olivia (PM), Raj (security), Lin (infra), Maya (CS lead), Tomas (eng). High-level success criteria I want us to agree on: 1) end-to-end integration with their S3 path + KMS, 2) latency P95 < 400ms for pilot traffic, 3) test data flow validated in staging, 4) enablement session + runbook handed to customer. Thoughts?

olivia_pm: Thanks Alex — sounds right. Can we confirm target pilot date? customer prefers Oct 20 window. budget/security reviews are blocking until legal signs off.

maya_success: Oct 20 is doable if we lock infra + security by next Tues (9/16). I'll own enablement docs and onboarding checklist.

raj_se: FYI I need their security questionnaire answers + SOC2 attestation PDF. Also we should plan a threat-model review for the VPC peering config. Can someone share contact at Medinexus for the security packets?

alex_cs: Contact is sara@medinexus.com. I asked for the questionnaire yesterday — she said they'll return it by end of day Friday.

lin_infra: On infra side: we'll need the CIDR ranges and egress rules. Also request a static NAT for their Egress if they want IP allowlisting. Who will open the ticket with cloud provider?

tomas_eng: I'll handle the cloud provision ticket once we have the CIDRs and KMS key policy. Also want to validate model variant — customer asked about Llama2-70B quantized vs 13B. For the pilot let's recommend 13B int8 to meet latency & cost goals.

onboard-bot: Scheduled: dev-vpc-provisioning job queued for 2025-09-10T14:00:00Z (owner: tomas_eng).

olivia_pm: Noted re model variant. Olivia -> Medinexus: prefer 13B pilot for faster turnaround. Also I'll coordinate legal follow-up with their procurement.

maya_success: Success criteria draft (I put into the checklist): "Integration smoke tests pass (S3+KMS), staging traffic shows P95 <= 400ms, 2 enablement sessions recorded, runbook shared, renewal signal captured (check-in at 60 days post-pilot)". Tagging Raj for security sign-off.

raj_se: I can sign off on security after we review the questionnaire and run a short ingress/egress proof-of-ownership test. Put the questionnaire in #secure-uploads or send to me directly.

alex_cs: I'll upload the questionnaire to the secure channel once Sara sends. Next steps: Olivia — confirm legal timeline. Lin/Tomas — cloud ticket + CIDRs by EOD Tue. Maya — finalize enablement plan by Wed. I'll sync again Fri for a readiness check. :thumbsup:
